# LedgerLite

Small web app for small restaurants to log server shifts (name, hours, tips) and see tip per hour.
Built by Maya after watching my parents' 40-seat restaurant track tips and shift hours on paper.

Status: working prototype. Single Python stdlib server (server.py) with an inline HTML/JS front end. Data is in memory only (resets on restart); no login yet.

Run: python3 server.py, then open http://localhost:8000

Next: persist data to a file, add per-shift editing, and test with a real restaurant.
